meaning:
ἐν-αγκαλίζομαι
(ἀγκάλη), [in LXX for חִבֻּק pi., Pro.6:10 24:33 * ;]
to take into one's arms: Mrk.9:36 10:16.†
(AS)
glosses: taking the child in his arms
took the children in his arms

renderings.bsb: Taking the child in His arms
He took the children in His arms

elsewhere.note: He took a little child, and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
